title: Convert Charges
text: 4 μC = 4 × 10⁻⁶ C and 6 μC = 6 × 10⁻⁶ C. Use magnitudes when calculating force magnitude.

title: Convert Distance
text: 30 cm = 0.30 m. Don't forget to square this: (0.30)² = 0.09 m².

title: Calculate
text: F = (9×10⁹)(4×10⁻⁶)(6×10⁻⁶)/(0.09) = (9×10⁹)(24×10⁻¹²)/0.09 = 0.216/0.09 = 2.4 N. Since charges are opposite, this force is attractive.
